# Score Anchor

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ScoreAnchor>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)

A pinned score range with its meaning and exemplars — 'range 0.8–1.0 means the text embodies the covenant, as in THIS passage'. Anchors are the rubric's calibration content; interpolation between anchors is solver work ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
